channel.title: Fall '26 Week 12 :: CIS 527 Textbook
channel.description: Resources Slides Video Script [00:00] Hello and welcome to the week 12 announcements video for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So this week you should be working on lab six. The quizzes for that are due Friday. We’ll have our fifth and final discussion session with the guest speaker next Wednesday. And then lab six will be due next Friday. So you’ll want to make sure you get that scheduled for grading before Thanksgiving. However, if you do notice that the week after that is Thanksgiving break. So if you wait all the way until the Monday after Thanksgiving break, there will just be a one day late penalty on lab six grading. So just keep that in mind. But lab six is due indeed a week from Friday. So lab six, we’re going to do a few things. We’re going to do file servers and drive mappings on both Windows and Linux. We’re also going to do some application server stuff on Windows and your Linux in the Cloud, and we’ll do some stuff working with web apps there as well. This one we’re going to jump around between different setups of the labs, but hopefully everything works out well for this. For those of you using Azure, you’ll be using your Windows servers in Azure a little bit for this for the file servers, drive mappings, and web apps. Once you get Lab 6 graded, that’s all we’re going to do with Windows server, so you can decommission those Azure things as soon as you get them graded on Lab 6. So if you’re concerned with that, you can work through Lab 6 pretty quickly and get that graded soon. The DigitalOcean stuff we’ll use through Lab 6 and Lab 7. So like I said, for lab seven, we’re going to have some stuff on backups. We’re going to do a little bit on monitoring and logging, and we’ll do an activity on DevOps dealing with some webhooks. So be prepared for that as well.
